Concrete CMS 9.5.1 release notes https://documentation.concretecms.org/9-x/developers/introduction/version-history/951-release-notes state that CVE-2026-8421 was fixed and describe the same source-to-sink mechanism.

bug_semantics: A cross-site request can route an authenticated administrator to install_package($package). Through 9.5.0, the method checks canInstallPackages but does not require POST and, when the package has no install-options screen, does not validate any CSRF token before resolving a package already present under DIR_PACKAGES/<handle>/ and invoking PackageService::install(), which executes its package controller as the web server user and can yield RCE.
flaw_origin: The vulnerable request-to-install shape first appears in the smallest surviving public Git object, root commit 10236caea734eeb055cd0aa18f3178bf1c6f7c0b: install_package($package) resolves the named package and calls $p->install() without request-method or CSRF validation. Repository history then carries the method through directory moves and refactors; none is a finer first writer.
